title: Spring Boot Queries With Zero SQL (It's Not Magic)
description:
Spring Data JPA can generate a real database query just from how you name a Java method — no SQL, no annotations. We break down how findByEmailAndActiveTrue and its siblings get parsed into a real query at startup, and why a typo fails the build instead of hiding in production.

Source lesson:
- https://sigilipelli.github.io/java-mastery-path/level-4/01-spring-ecosystem-production/

#Shorts

beats.narration: You can write a real Spring Boot database query without writing a single line of SQL — just by naming a Java method correctly.

Spring Data parses the method name at startup and turns it into a real query. Find by email and active true becomes select from users where email matches, and active is true — a full query, and you never wrote it.
And Spring Data isn't guessing — it validates every method name against your entity at startup. Typo a field name, and the app refuses to boot instead of failing silently in production.

display.heading: It fails fast, not silently
display.subheading: Spring validates every method name against your entity at startup.
